brief:
Gadi Eisenkot, an opposition figure in Israeli politics, is working to remove Benjamin Netanyahu from his position as Prime Minister, Al Jazeera English reported. Eisenkot's efforts represent a significant move within Israel's political landscape as internal pressure mounts against Netanyahu's continued leadership.

The push comes amid ongoing political tensions within Israel, though specific details about Eisenkot's strategy or the timing of his efforts were not immediately available.
dek: Israeli opposition leader Gadi Eisenkot appears to be pushing to oust Benjamin Netanyahu as Prime Minister.
title: Israeli opposition leader Eisenkot pushes to oust Netanyahu
